work.title: Untitled (Turquoise Pictograph Field)
work.description: Turquoise ground dominates a wide-format composition layered with gestural ink marks, crude figural pictographs, and overlapping paint patches in yellow, magenta, green, and ochre. Primitive stick figures, arrows, and looping linear marks are distributed across the surface in a densely worked, all-over arrangement.
work.composition: All-over gestural marks on turquoise ground
keywords: multi-patch color field with figural graffiti
